summary: Completed testing of OpenTicket ticketing platform with Stripe Connect payments. All backend APIs working correctly including the new /api/stripe/verify-session endpoint. Frontend loads and displays events correctly.

minor.issue: The public preview URL (https://edit-blocker-1.preview.emergentagent.com) returns Framer landing page instead of routing to the app. Backend works on localhost:8001.

issues: 'Pricing' link appears twice in the header navigation bar

action_items: Investigate why public preview URL is not routing to the app (ingress/nginx configuration issue)
critical_code_review_comments: The verify-session endpoint is properly implemented in /app/backend/controllers/stripeController.js (line 378)
Frontend correctly calls /api/stripe/verify-session in EventView.tsx (line 121) for payment verification
The endpoint properly validates sessionId, retrieves Stripe session, and updates registration status
seed_data_creation: Used existing events in Supabase database
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is Express.js (not FastAPI) running on port 8001. Frontend is Vite/React on port 3000. Routes use HashRouter - use /#/browse for events list, /#/event/:id for event details. The verify-session endpoint was added to fix payment timeout issues by bypassing webhook delays.
